column1: At Amazon locations around the world, more than 4,500 employees join together
as Sustainability Ambassadors—a grassroots organization of Amazonians working
to expand the efforts of the global teams that work directly on managing Amazon’s
environmental and social impacts. The Sustainability Ambassadors program started in
2017 with chapters in corporate offices and fulfillment centers in the U.S. and Europe.
The program continues to expand, now with over 160 teams around the world.
